en: Vintage monochrome view of a large two‑storey railway station building with arched ground‑floor windows and shuttered upper windows. A clock sits in a small pediment at the roofline. In front of the station, people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand, with a few carriages and carts visible. The caption at the top left reads "Trento - Stazione Ferroviaria."
